## Service approach
HydroSeal evaluates paver or stone material, existing sealer or coating, joint condition, moisture, staining, drainage, repairs and exposure before selecting preparation and sealing methods. Paver work may include targeted stain treatment, deep cleaning, re-sanding, agreed small repairs or releveling and application of a compatible breathable sealer. Travertine and natural stone use stone-appropriate cleaning and protection rather than a generic concrete-paver process.

Concrete and brick paver sealing starts at $1.50 per square foot. Travertine and natural stone sealing starts at $1.60 per square foot. Final pricing is confirmed after photo review or inspection and may change with stripping, stain treatment, repairs, access, moisture or other preparation requirements.

HydroSeal is licensed and insured and is a Trident Master Certified paver sealing applicator. Qualifying paver sealing projects include a written two-year workmanship and adhesion warranty.
